name: Granola
description: Granola's hosted server lets the agent search and read your meeting notes, so decisions made in a call reach the work.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (mcp-auth.granola.ai) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
